id: Sunset Guided Tour-Stonehenge Aotearoa, 51 Ahiaruhe Rd, Carterton-Event Finder
name: Sunset Guided Tour
venue: Stonehenge Aotearoa, 51 Ahiaruhe Rd, Carterton
long_description:
Experience Stonehenge Aotearoa at its most breathtaking — as the sun dips below the Wairarapa horizon.
Our Sunset Guided Tour blends astronomy, storytelling, and the natural beauty of twilight for an evening you will never forget.

Led by one of our knowledgeable guides, this 90-minute experience explores how ancient cultures used the Sun to track time and mark the turning of the seasons. You’ll discover the scientific and cultural thinking behind the Henge’s unique Southern Hemisphere design before watching the sunset alignment from inside the stone circle.

Weather permitting, you’ll witness how the setting Sun interacts with the structure — a striking moment that links ancient knowledge with the rhythms of the natural world.

Duration and Schedule
• Allow: Approximately 90 minutes
• Start Time: Begins one hour before sunset
• Availability: Offered any day with advance booking

id: Self-Guided Tour of Stonehenge Aotearoa-Stonehenge Aotearoa, 51 Ahiaruhe Rd, Carterton-Event Finder
name: Self-Guided Tour of Stonehenge Aotearoa
venue: Stonehenge Aotearoa, 51 Ahiaruhe Rd, Carterton
long_description:
Explore Stonehenge Aotearoa at Your Own Pace

Our self-guided tour includes a map and a 12-minute audio-visual presentation to help you uncover the secrets of the henge. Afterward, head down to the stone circle and try out its unique acoustics — clap your hands and hear the echo respond, or whisper and see how far your voice carries.

A self-guided tour typically takes around 30 minutes, but many visitors stay longer simply because it’s so much fun. The bigger your group, the better the experience!

Please arrive at least 30 minutes before closing time.
Available during our opening hours: 10 AM – 4 PM.

id: Shared 90-Minute Guided Tour-Stonehenge Aotearoa, 51 Ahiaruhe Rd, Carterton-Event Finder
name: Shared 90-Minute Guided Tour
venue: Stonehenge Aotearoa, 51 Ahiaruhe Rd, Carterton
long_description:
Join a Shared Guided Tour and experience Stonehenge Aotearoa through the eyes of an expert. In this 90-minute journey, you’ll uncover how ancient cultures measured time, tracked the Sun and Moon, and connected the heavens with life on Earth.

Your experience begins with a captivating introduction and a 15-minute audio-visual presentation explaining how the Henge works. Then, step outside with your guide for a detailed tour of the stone circle, where astronomy, archaeology, and mythology come together in one unforgettable setting.

Perfect for visitors seeking a deeper understanding of the stars and stories that shaped human history.

id: Manon - with Pene Pati and Amina Edris-St James Theatre, 77-87 Courtenay Place, Wellington-Event Finder
name: Manon - with Pene Pati and Amina Edris
venue: St James Theatre, 77-87 Courtenay Place, Wellington
long_description:
Wellington Opera proudly presents Manon, Jules Massenet’s quintessentially French opera of the belle époque.​

Amina Edris enchants audiences worldwide with her radiant soprano voice and captivating stage presence, while Pene Pati is beloved by many for his role in the chart-topping trio Sol3 Mio, and has since become one of the most sought-after tenors on the global stage. Phillip Rhodes returns following his wonderful performances in La Traviata and Lucia di Lammermoor.

Wellington Opera brings these wonderful Kiwi artists home to perform this sumptuous masterpiece at the St James Theatre, Wellington with French conductor Romain Dumas and Aotearoa’s renowned opera director Sara Brodie.

For one week only!

id: The Cheese Bar-Garage Project Wild Workshop, 7 Furness Lane Te Aro, Wellington, Wellington-Event Finder
name: The Cheese Bar
venue: Garage Project Wild Workshop, 7 Furness Lane Te Aro, Wellington, Wellington
long_description:
After a barnstormer last year, Garage Project and Le Marché Français return with Cheese Bar, a carefully selected cheese and beer experience popping up for three nights at the Wild Workshop.

This is à la bonne franquette: no bookings, no set menus, just exceptional French and locally sourced cheeses matched beautifully with beer.

Build your own board from a counter display of soft, washed rind, bloomy rind, alpine-style, goat's milk, and blue cheeses.

Comté in multiple ages, Brie de Meaux, Camembert-style options, chèvres, and French blues. Or order a guided tasting cheese and beer flight with Garage Project and Wild Workshop beers.

Cheese-forward small plates, baked brie with seasonal accompaniments, raclette-style melted cheese over potatoes and cornichons, croque-monsieur-inspired toasties, cheese, and charcuterie boards, round out the offering.

id: World of Whisky: a Guided Tasting-Wellington East By West Ferry, 1 Queens Wharf, Wellington-Event Finder
name: World of Whisky: a Guided Tasting
venue: Wellington East By West Ferry, 1 Queens Wharf, Wellington
long_description:
Whisky on the Harbour with First Phil

Join us aboard Ika Rere for an evening of whisky tasting on Wellington Harbour.

Hosted by Phil Gow (First Phil), a respected New Zealand whisky educator and creator behind a globally recognised whisky platform, known for his engaging and down-to-earth approach.

Over the course of the cruise, you’ll sample a selection of whiskies from around the world while learning about their origins, production, and the unique characteristics that make each one different. Whether you’re new to whisky or already have a favourite dram, this is a relaxed and approachable experience designed to be enjoyed by everyone.

As we cruise around on the Southern Hemisphere’s first fully electric passenger ferry, you’ll have the chance to enjoy good company, great whisky, and a different perspective of the city.

Your ticket includes 5 drams, a guided whisky tasting, light snacks and a scenic cruise. Additional beverages will be available for purchase from our licensed onboard bar.

id: Local Library-Circa Theatre, 1 Taranaki St, Wellington-Event Finder
name: Local Library
venue: Circa Theatre, 1 Taranaki St, Wellington
long_description:
Local Library is an affectionate comedy about libraries, loneliness, local bodies, busy-bodies and the bloody city council.

Paul Homewood is a grumpy retired widower who enjoys walking dogs and reading the speeches of Winston Churchill. Uptight and separated Helen Nielsen prefers E Annie Proulx. When Helen, a senior librarian, catches Paul ripping off the system at her suburban library, she bans him. He can only return if he reads a book that she recommends. Could a friendship develop from this book war? And who are the shady figures threatening to disrupt Helen’s drag storytime?

Review:
“Armstrong’s ability to write a drama that is both contemporary and universal puts him at the top of the league table of Kiwi playwrights” New Zealand Listener

Written by Dave Armstrong
Directed by Conrad Newport
Starring Peter Hambleton and Jude Gibson
Design by William Smith – Tungsten Projects
Produced by Armstrong Creative

Sat 25 July – Sat 22 August
Tues – Sat 7.30pm, Sunday 4.30pm
Preview Night: Friday 24 July
Sunday Special: Sunday 26 July
Choose Your Price Night and Q&A Night: Tuesday 28 July
CIRCA TWO
$25 -$60
Duration: 90 minutes no interval
Audience Care: Contains some swearing and serious discussion of literature

id: Public Service Announcements – Election Meltdown-Circa Theatre, 1 Taranaki St, Wellington-Event Finder
name: Public Service Announcements – Election Meltdown
venue: Circa Theatre, 1 Taranaki St, Wellington
long_description:
Aotearoa’s longest running political satire series, Public Service Announcements, is back at Circa Theatre to crash another election party!

From the depths of bureaucracy, from the bowels of the Beehive, amidst the rise of a three-headed taniwha, protests and strikes… another election looms and the politicians swarm.

Coalitions crumble, loyalties burn, Winston probably survives another term somehow and the nation faces a meltdown it really didn’t vote for.

Irreverent and rowdy, PSA delivers up-to-the-minute raucous political comedy and features Pōneke’s funniest performers.

Public Service Announcements began as a late night comedy experiment in 2011, created by James Nokise and Anya Tate-Manning. Over the last 5 election cycles we have created 19 original productions at BATs and Circa Theatre, and over 100 artists have worked on PSA across the last 15 years.

PSA balances smart and stupid; inside political gags and fart jokes, a ruthless investigation of leaders and election promises, but most importantly side-splitting, pants-wetting comedy.

This time Carrie Green takes the wheel as Director, and we have an all-star line-up of hilarious Wellington performers, and a team of razor sharp writers and designers.

id: Eat Your Art Out-Museum of New Zealand Te Papa Tongarewa, 55 Cable St, Wellington-Event Finder
name: Eat Your Art Out
venue: Museum of New Zealand Te Papa Tongarewa, 55 Cable St, Wellington
long_description:
A high tea to delight your eyes and taste buds – with new menu inspired by Slow Burn: Women and Photography.

Inspired by Slow Burn: Women and Photography, the latest Eat Your Art Out high tea menu takes its cue from the world of photography.

From the delicate A Heart Exposed and the rich depth of The Chocolate Camera, to the savoury kick of The Apricot Proof, each item has been crafted by our award-winning chefs and is ready for its close-up.

Your high tea includes your choice of tea or coffee, with alcoholic beverages available to purchase. Dietary options are available on request.

Every purchase helps support Aotearoa New Zealand’s national museum.


Set Menu
(Includes one of each item per person)

A Heart Exposed
A delicate petite gâteau of tropical guava mousse layered with a vibrant raspberry centre, finished with refined textures and a balance of sweetness, bright berry acidity, and silky indulgence.

The Matcha Take
A refined Japanese-inspired madeleine infused with premium matcha, baked to a tender crumb with gentle earthy depth. Paired with luscious matcha ganache and sharp citrus bursts of yuzu gel.

The Chocolate Camera
An elegant chocolate creation showcasing the rich, velvety depth of premium Whittaker’s chocolate balanced with the vibrant citrus brightness of calamansi.

Golden Hour
A radiant tropical dessert crafted with luscious mango mousse and vibrant passionfruit notes, layered to create a light yet indulgent finish.

The Apricot Proof
A savoury petite muffin featuring sweet roasted capsicum folded through a soft, buttery crumb with delicate pockets of apricot for subtle fruity warmth.

Chicken Strut
Delicately layered smoked chicken paired with crisp cucumber ribbons, peppery rocket, and vibrant red pesto, nestled between soft artisan bread.

Green Screen Sandwich (V)
A beautifully balanced vegetarian finger sandwich showcasing tender grilled courgette, slow-roasted vegetable chutney, and fresh baby spinach.


Dietary Menu
(Includes one of each item per person)

The Mango Still (VE/GF)
A smooth mango mousse encased in a delicate chocolate shell, showcasing the fruit’s natural sweetness.

Peanut Butter Proof (VE/GF)
A rich peanut butter slice topped with a chocolate finish, balancing salty depth with a smooth, indulgent crumb.

Chocolate Darkroom (VE/GF)
Dark chocolate cups filled with smooth espresso-infused ganache, rich and intense from start to finish.

Matcha Moment (VE/GF)
Matcha chocolate shells with a bright citrus centre, balancing earthy green tea notes against a fresh citrus snap.

Apricot Aperture (VE/GF)
A vibrant apricot fruit jelly with an intense natural fruit flavour, finished with a delicate sugar coating for a clean, bright bite.

The Garden Negative (VE)
Tender grilled courgette layered with slow-roasted vegetable chutney and fresh baby spinach.

Fritter in Focus (VE)
Golden corn fritters served with beetroot mayonnaise, mesclun leaves, and vine-ripened tomatoes.


Paired with your choice of coffee or tea.

Alcoholic beverages are available for purchase.

Pre-booking is essential for any dietary requirements.

id: Discover Te Muna - Explore the Wines-Escarpment Winery, 275 Te Muna Road, Martinborough-Event Finder
name: Discover Te Muna - Explore the Wines
venue: Escarpment Winery, 275 Te Muna Road, Martinborough
long_description:
Born from passionate vignerons who embrace the challenge of extreme weather conditions, Te Muna valley's unique microclimate and soil structure result in exceptional wines with distinctive style.
Join us for an interactive tasting led by wine writer and educator Joelle Thomson, as we explore a curated selection of Te Muna wines from a variety of producers.

You will be picked up from the Square in Martinborough and driven to the stunning Escarpment vineyard. Joelle will guide you through a tasting of twelve of Te Muna wines. The experience concludes with a relaxed opportunity to revisit some of your favourites while meeting several of the producers, before being transported back to the Square.

Tickets are strictly limited to 18 people.

venue: The Beer Engine, 31 Whitehouse Road, Tītahi Bay, Porirua 5022, Porirua - Mana
long_description:
Elvis has left the building and he's now in Titahi Bay, running a wedding chapel just for you. This is a truly unique experience where you can either live out your dream of getting married in a Las Vegas wedding chapel either just for fun, or legally. Arrive in a convertible Cadillac with bubbles in hand, step into a sanctuary where the King himself is celebrant, MC, photographer, and musical send-off rolled into one gloriously ridiculous evening.

After the ceremony (legally binding or symbolic, your choice), newlyweds are seated for a refined take on Elvis's signature sandwich: peanut butter mousse, candied bacon, and banana on brioche. Tater tots on the side. A slice of red velvet wedding cake to cut and share. Elvis karaoke and Elvistravaganza festivities carry the night forward, because what else would you do after getting married in a chapel run by the King?

Wedding packages vary; you can have an Elvis commitment ceremony just for fun, a vow renewal for a bit more seriousness (with a bit of help beforehand) but also
an Aoteroa New Zealand Legal wedding/union is available - ticketholders will be contacted to confirm all the details are just right - and will get extra pre-time with the celebrant to get all the proper legal details done.

Wedding tickets are per couple and include: transport in the Cadillac, glass of travelling bubbles, wedding ceremony and certificate, breakfast, wedding cake, photographs, wedding album, sandwich, sides, and a cocktail or non-alcoholic alternative each. Additional alcohol is available for purchase.

name: Moksha - 5 Year Anniversary
venue: Valhalla, 154 Vivian Street, Wellington
long_description:
TEAM MOKSHA PRESENTS

MOKSHA -5 Year Anniversary Gathering
08 AUGUST 2026 | VALHALLA, WELLINGTON

Five years.

Honestly, it's hard to believe.

What started as a small dream between a few friends has grown into something far bigger than we ever imagined.

Over the last five years, we've shared dancefloors, sunsets, sunrises, laughter, hugs, friendships, and countless unforgettable moments together. We've watched strangers become friends, friends become family, and a community grow around a shared love for music, connection, and freedom.

Our recent gathering, AARANYA , reminded us once again how special this community truly is. Seeing so many beautiful souls come together, dancing under the open sky, sharing smiles and creating memories, filled our hearts with gratitude.

To every artist who has played our stages.
To every volunteer who has helped behind the scenes.
To every person who bought a ticket, shared a post, invited a friend, or danced with us until sunrise...

THANK YOU !

Team Moksha wouldn't exist without you.

As we step into our fifth year, we wanted to celebrate this milestone together.

On Saturday, 08 August, we return to Valhalla Wellington for a special anniversary gathering.

No egos.
No expectations.

Just good music, good people, and the energy that happens when our community comes together as one.

Expect a carefully curated journey through sound, immersive visuals, and the unmistakable atmosphere that has always made Moksha feel like home.

Whether you've been with us since day one or you're about to join us for your very first event, this night is for you.

Let's celebrate five years of music, friendship, growth, and community.

And let's create a few more memories together.

We can't wait to see your faces on the dancefloor again.

With love,

Team Moksha

Five years later, the music still calls us together.
Welcome home.
